content.content: A missing exclude file reads as empty: when `.git/info/exclude` does not exist the read yields no lines, not a failure.
content.rationale: A fresh repository may have no `.git/info/exclude`, and the bootstrap must still record the state directory there. Absence is the empty state, reached the way markers reach it (S5-marker-initial, lspnqzzz): the read stays total and the append writes the entry into a file that is not yet there, rather than reporting a failure the caller must unwind.
